steps.what: Observe the actual crime scene, identify evidence and determine collection and preservation requirements
inputs: actual scene, evidence and authorised investigation scope
actual collection/preservation procedures

steps.what: Collect evidence from crime scenes with the actual method, avoiding contamination and maintaining item identity
inputs: technician-identified evidence and preservation needs
actual tools, scene condition and collection procedure
outputs: actual collected evidence with technician-established item identity

steps.what: Package and label the actual collected evidence and check item/package identity, preservation condition and intended secure storage location
inputs: actual collected evidence with technician-established item identity
actual packaging/preservation requirements and available secure storage
outputs: exact checked evidence package, identity, required condition and intended storage location

steps.what: Store the exact checked evidence package in the intended conditions that preserve its integrity
inputs: exact checked evidence package, identity, required condition and intended storage location
outputs: actual evidence stored in checked preservation conditions

steps.what: Enter and check actual collection, package, custody and storage-location facts in forensic evidence records (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: actual collected evidence with technician-established item identity
actual evidence stored in checked preservation conditions
technician's actual collection/custody facts
outputs: exact checked evidence/custody entries and intended case/item records

steps.what: Save the exact checked collection/custody entries in the intended evidence records
inputs: exact checked evidence/custody entries and intended case/item records

tasks.design: Configure case/item-context entry in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the forensic evidence record system. The technician collects, packages and checks the actual evidence before physical storage, then captures/checks the actual collection and custody facts before saving the record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated case/item identifiers add a small record-entry burden.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case-context forms can reuse fixed identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Evidence recognition, contamination control, packaging and preservation are physical professional work.
tasks.human_edge: Preserve actual evidence integrity and document what really happened.

ambition.what: No automated evidence handling or inferred custody history.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; evidence custodian validates record scopes and field reuse

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native evidence-record context can reduce repeated identifiers while evidence handling and custody facts require actual technician work.

assumptions: Unmeasured recorded collection/storage episode. Gross 9 x .10 = .9; upkeep .25; net .65 hours per 100.

Technician produces item identity, labels, collection and storage facts in s1-s5. Only existing fixed case/item identifiers are reused; no new barcode inventory, location map or inferred custody events assumed free.
Physical storage follows s3's exact package/location/condition check; changed package, location or preservation condition requires renewed checking. Storage labour is fully retained.
Record authoring/check s5 occurs after actual storage and gates its exact final record/destination in s6. Same-system save 1 is fully retained with no saving; edits invalidate gate.
No external transfer or report send is promised. Shared custody entry with general case reporting must be counted once.
unknowns: Actual repeated fixed identifiers and present case-context features
research_questions: Which case/item fields are retyped separately from actual custody facts?

already_counted.description: Scene/evidence work, physical storage and actual custody record entry/check

incremental.description: Maintain and spot-check case/item context mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual evidence package, identity, required condition and intended location checked in s3; changes require recheck
Exact completed actual collection/custody record and destinations checked in s5; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 fixed-entry scenario below .65% modeled net; physical collection/preservation retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep forensic records and prepare findings reports

steps.what: Retrieve and reconcile actual case records, investigative methods, laboratory techniques and findings in forensic case/laboratory records (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: actual contemporaneous case notes and evidence identities
actual laboratory method, result and quality records from their producers
outputs: technician-reviewed case evidence and explicit missing/contradictory records

steps.what: Determine the actual supported forensic findings, method descriptions, limitations and required case-record updates
inputs: technician-reviewed case evidence and explicit missing/contradictory records
actual authorised report scope and reporting requirements
outputs: technician-authored supported findings, methods, limitations and record corrections

steps.what: Keep records and prepare reports detailing findings, investigative methods and laboratory techniques, entering actual updates and drafting supported narrative
inputs: technician-authored supported findings, methods, limitations and record corrections
actual reconciled source records and case identity
outputs: complete candidate case-record updates and source-linked report

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory report prose from technician-selected actual findings and methods
loop.input: Exact case source records and technician-authored supported findings/methods/limitations
loop.output: Candidate explanatory passages with source references; record values remain direct entry/template fields
loop.check: Technician checks all findings, sequence, method descriptions, numbers and limitations against originals in s4
loop.stop: Missing evidence, contradictory identity, unsupported inference or two failed revisions stops drafting for manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates handle metadata and fixed results first; explanation of actual methods and findings requires meaning choices beyond field substitution

steps.what: Check and correct the complete final case-record updates and forensic report, source identity, methods, findings, limits and intended internal revisions
inputs: complete candidate case-record updates and source-linked report
actual original case/laboratory records and supported conclusions
outputs: exact checked final record updates/report and internal destinations

steps.what: Save the exact checked case-record updates and report to their intended internal revisions
inputs: exact checked final record updates/report and internal destinations
outputs: saved internal forensic case records and report

tasks.design: Configure source views and native record/report templates in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the forensic case/laboratory record system, and {DOCS}, adding a bounded loop only for explanatory prose. The technician supplies supported findings, enters real record changes and checks the complete final records/report before saving the exact internal revisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Record navigation and explanatory prose authoring add work beyond fixed report fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links plus bounded source-grounded prose drafting can reduce navigation and candidate writing.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible forensic account can introduce unsupported inference or obscure limitations.
tasks.human_edge: State only what actual evidence and methods support.

ambition.what: No automatic forensic conclusion, formal release or court submission.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; forensic records/quality owner approves source access and bounded drafting

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded source-linked explanatory drafting can assist forensic reporting, with factual, inferential and method checks retained by the technician.

assumptions: Unmeasured actual case-record/report episode. Gross 25 x .10 + 30 x .15 = 7; upkeep 2; net 5 hours per 100.

Actual contemporaneous records already exist from case/test work; technician retrieves/reconciles them in s1 and captures actual updates in s2-s3. Missing facts remain missing and require manual resolution, not reconstructed evidence.
Native fixed fields/templates first. Loop only drafts supported explanatory prose, never evidence values, identification decisions or new findings; full verification/repair remains counted.

Internal save is a batch record/report commit in the same case system with 1 fully retained point and no saving. If separate commits are actually required, each must receive its own exact-version check/action with no save-click saving.

s4 checks final completed content and destinations before s5; edits invalidate gate. No formal external report send is promised. Do not double count original custody or result entry already allocated to collection/testing.
unknowns: Actual draft correction burden and source completeness
research_questions: Does bounded narrative drafting reduce total writing/checking time without unsupported inference or identity errors?

already_counted.description: Source reconciliation, supported conclusions, actual record entry, draft review and final checking

incremental.description: Maintain permitted source context and evaluate narrative/source checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed case-record/report contents and internal destinations checked in s4; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 source-navigation/prose scenario below 5% modeled net; no automatic conclusion or free record capture.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Photograph or video evidence and scenes

steps.what: Choose and check actual evidence/scene coverage, framing, scales, camera settings and authorised photographic capture plan
inputs: actual evidence or crime scene and required documentation scope
actual camera condition, capture procedure and scene constraints
outputs: checked exact capture plan, framing/settings and scene readiness

steps.what: Use photographic or video equipment to document actual evidence or crime scenes following the checked capture plan and inspecting actual captures
inputs: checked exact capture plan, framing/settings and scene readiness
actual visible evidence/scene conditions
outputs: actual original evidence photographs/video and technician's capture facts

steps.what: Load actual original captures, enter/check case/item links and capture facts, and verify image completeness and intended record destination in forensic image/evidence records (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: actual original evidence photographs/video and technician's capture facts
actual case/item identifiers and permitted original-image storage
outputs: exact checked original-image set, actual metadata/links and internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked original evidence image set and actual metadata to the intended internal evidence record
inputs: exact checked original-image set, actual metadata/links and internal destination
outputs: saved original evidence images and actual record links

tasks.design: Configure native case/item-context entry and direct existing camera metadata mapping in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the forensic image/evidence record system. The technician chooses and checks coverage, captures the real scene, enters actual missing capture facts and checks the original-image set before its internal commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated case/item and already available camera metadata entry adds image-record handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native image intake can reuse existing file metadata and fixed case context.
tasks.still_hard: Coverage, framing and actual capture quality determine whether the record faithfully documents the scene.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise missing views and preserve the distinction between original captures and interpretation.

ambition.what: No synthetic evidence image, automatic scene interpretation or image alteration.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; image/evidence custodian validates original-file and metadata handling

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native original-image intake can reuse camera metadata and case identifiers while forensic photographic coverage remains technician work.

assumptions: Unmeasured photographic documentation episode. Gross 29 x .10 = 2.9; upkeep 1; net 1.9 hours per 100.

Technician produces actual captures and capture facts in s1-s3; only metadata already in original camera files and existing case identifiers are mapped. Unknown times, object identities or views are never inferred.

Capture planning/readiness s1 gates actual capture s2; changes in plan, framing/settings or scene require renewed judgment. Camera operation remains fully retained; no saving from native camera runtime.
s3 checks the complete resulting original-image set and actual links after capture before s4; edits to set/links require recheck. Same-system record commit 1 stays fully retained and earns no saving.
No external transfer or altered/enhanced image product is promised.
unknowns: Current native image metadata intake and actual re-entry
research_questions: Which metadata are actually copied manually, and can native intake preserve original files and provenance?

already_counted.description: Capture planning, actual photography/video and resulting original-image record checking

incremental.description: Maintain and test native original-image metadata/case mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact capture plan, framing/settings and current scene readiness checked in s1; changes require renewed checking
Exact complete actual original-image set, metadata, case links and destination checked in s3; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 existing-metadata entry scenario below 1.9% modeled net; physical capture and evidentiary checking retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Testify about forensic methods and findings

steps.what: Read actual case evidence, method records, findings and limitations relevant to the court testimony in forensic case records (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: actual court testimony scope and case identity
actual evidence, laboratory methods, reported findings and limitations
outputs: technician's reviewed factual and methodological testimony context

steps.what: Testify in court about actual investigative or analytical methods or findings, answering questions and making uncertainty and limits clear
inputs: technician's reviewed factual and methodological testimony context
actual court questions and evidence shown in court
outputs: actual oral testimony and explanations to the court

tasks.design: Configure current case/method reference views in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the forensic case record system. The technician reads actual evidence and limitations and provides the testimony and live answers personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Navigating the correct case and method records can add preparation effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case/reference views can reduce navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Questions, evidentiary boundaries and uncertainty must be handled in live testimony.
tasks.human_edge: Give accurate, comprehensible answers and acknowledge limits under questioning.

ambition.what: No generated testimony or expanded expert authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; case custodian validates restricted record access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native case-reference views can reduce navigation while forensic court testimony and questioning remain the witness's work.

assumptions: Unmeasured preparation/testimony episode. Gross 30 x .05 = 1.5; upkeep .5; net 1 hour per 100.
Actual case records already exist; witness reads and verifies relevant context in s1. Missing records require manual clarification and no generated substitute.

Only navigation changes, not factual preparation or testimony. This is live oral testimony, not a prepared statement send or case-record amendment; no report-writing or post-court record requirement is invented.
If a separate written statement or record amendment is actually required, its authoring/check and each send/commit need separate steps rather than being assumed free within testimony.
unknowns: Actual navigation burden versus substantive preparation
research_questions: Does case-reference navigation consume measurable time after preserving full testimony preparation?

already_counted.description: Remaining actual evidence preparation and live testimony

incremental.description: Maintain and spot-check restricted case/reference views

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 navigation-only scenario below 1% modeled net; live testimony fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Preserve original evidence and actual provenance
Separate supported findings from hypotheses and drafting suggestions
Keep physical evidence actions distinct from record commits
role.ambitious_version: Use tightly scoped native forensic record views and bounded explanatory drafting to reduce clerical handling while technicians retain physical evidence integrity, supported conclusions and personal court testimony.
